name: 鸭吉吉
habitat: 野外捕捉精灵介绍：似乎不会发生进化。 充满勇气的伙伴，有一种熟悉却又神秘的感觉。 在特殊魔力的影响下，会改变自身的身体构造。
habitatEn: Catch in the wild. Creature introduction: it does not seem to evolve. A companion full of courage, with a familiar yet mysterious feeling. Under the influence of special magic, it changes its own body structure.
evolution: 鸭吉吉 → 鸭吉吉国王
description: “嘎！嘎！”火烧鸭屁股了，快让一让。燃了鸭总是处于紧张炸毛的状态，立毛反射会增大它自身的轮廓，看起来体型更大，因此，在鸭吉吉种族里，燃了鸭是不好惹的代名词。
descriptionEn: "Quack! Quack!" Its butt is on fire, make way. Burnt Duck is always in a tense, fluffed-up state; the piloerection reflex enlarges its own outline and makes it look bigger, so within the Duckiji species, Burnt Duck is synonymous with "not to be messed with".

skills.name: 猛烈撞击
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成物理伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage to the enemy.

skills.name: 扫尾
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成物理伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage to the enemy.

skills.name: 防御
skills.descriptionEn: Reduces damage taken by 70%, counters attacks.

skills.name: 咆哮
skills.descriptionEn: The enemy gets ATK -60% and SPD -60.

skills.name: 吓退
skills.description: 减伤60%，应对攻击：敌方脱离。
skills.descriptionEn: Reduces damage taken by 60%; countering attacks: the enemy withdraws.

skills.name: 见招拆招
skills.description: 造成物伤，若上回合使用状态技能，本次技能威力+55。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; if a status skill was used last turn, this skill's power +55.

skills.name: 伺机而动
skills.description: 下一次攻击时，技能威力+70。
skills.descriptionEn: On the next attack, the skill's power +70.

skills.name: 吨位压制
skills.description: 造成物伤，敌方体重越低，威力越高。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; the lower the enemy's weight, the higher the power.

skills.name: 快速移动
skills.description: 自己获得速度+80，应对防御：改为速度+160。
skills.descriptionEn: Gains SPD +80; countering defense: SPD +160 instead.
